description:
The board: paid work on the store's games. No quest_id: every bounty
    plus `games`; `game` narrows (e.g. 'gates'); quest_id: one bounty.
    `gates-pr` pays the posted price for any PR accepted into
    github.com/AnthonE/Gates, `fireplace-pr` the same for
    github.com/AnthonE/Fireplace. Deliver with play(action='munus.submit',
    args={quest_id, url, wallet}); call unsigned first for the text to sign.
    docs('start') is the loop. Labor pricing, never a reading; merge stays a
    human act.
name: munus
